The <b>Hunter's Heart</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] and [[Materium#Mementos|memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The Hunter's Heart is used along with the [[Pollen Heart]], the [[Encrusted Heart]], and/or the [[Conjoined Heart]] to complete the <i>[[SEEK: The Old Hearts]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Red Memory.png!Snail Shamans location in Moss Grotto
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Snail Shamans 01.png!Snail Shamans in the Ruined Chapel in Moss Grotto
}}

If the Hunter's Heart is obtained afterwards, as a fourth heart, then it becomes a [[memento]] that can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]]. After interacting with the desk, it appears in the top-middle slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Hunter's Heart 02.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Hunter's Heart is acquired after defeating [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]] in [[Far Fields]]. This requires entering her memory using the [[Elegy of the Deep]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Skarrsinger Karmelita 01.png!Location in Far Fields
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Hunter's Heart 01.png!Hunter's Heart next to Skarrsinger Karmelita's corpse in Far Fields
}}
